title: Lamar Jackson on coaching change: Like a breath of fresh air because everything is new

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson on coaching change: Like a breath of fresh air because everything is new
sources.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said on Wednesday that he was "shocked" to learn that John Harbaugh was fired as the team's head coach earlier this year, but he's embracing the arrival of the new coaching staff.
